## Coaching Note

**The Move: Qxc3+**

Notice that White's knight on c3 was pinned to the king—it couldn't move safely. When your opponent plays Qd5 attacking your pieces, look for pieces that are immobilized by pins. Here, capturing the pinned knight with check forces the king to deal with the check, and then either pawn recapture or rook block both lose to back-rank mates. Always hunt for checks that exploit pins!
